scope: Two bounded read-only/noanalysis Ghidra exports from the installed EnabledUP15Units engine; native configuration/header/table checks. No original files, gameplay rules or weather RNG changed.

verifiedFunctions.finding: Calendar constructor writes vtable, currentMonth0, cycleMonthtrue, secondsPerYear1200, yearTimer0, yearsPlayed0, stopMonth-1.
Copies year length and cycle flag from supplied settings; initializes yearTimer=(secondsPerYear/12)*requestedMonth for a valid month0..11.

Adds supplied elapsed time when cycling; wraps at secondsPerYear and increments yearsPlayed. Assembly computes currentMonth=truncate(yearTimer/(secondsPerYear*1/12)). Optional stopMonth may stop cycling.
Changes secondsPerYear and rescales yearTimer by new/old to preserve annual phase.
Returns elapsed seconds within current month by subtracting currentMonth*monthlyDuration from yearTimer.
EE2Season update forwards the same supplied delta to Calendar, then invokes season/weather/lighting-related updates.
Installed patch wrapper calls an optional function pointer before native Calendar initialization; untracked live patch settings are not inferred.

sourceInterpolation.rule: Ordered texture list is interpolated evenly across the year; twelve textures give one per month.
sourceInterpolation.gpuImplementation: Eight native-size RGBA8 texture arrays, twelve monthly layers each; adjacent monthly texture samples mixed by the normalized month fraction.

ownAdapter.phaseSource: Current deterministic WASM tick, reduced modulo integral year duration, plus explicit startMonth.
ownAdapter.rateStatus: Matches native1200-second constructor year; summer starting month is an application choice.
ownAdapter.saveLoadAndNetwork: Calendar settings must accompany a save/host setup. Phase is recomputed from restored/current tick without a wall-clock timer or accumulated render deltas.
ownAdapter.floatDifference: Original accumulates floating elapsed-time steps; the render-only adapter derives phase from integer ticks and does not reproduce native float drift or all live patch hooks.

weatherSourceOnly.status: Availability/source fields only. No rain/snow scheduling, boundary inclusivity, random event probability/duration, precipitation geometry or gameplay weather penalties are reconstructed by these fields alone.

open: Live front-end/random starting-season selection and patch callbacks
Complete seasonal tint/weather/lighting and vegetation changes
Weather queue RNG, event probabilities and durations
